definitions.full: H4872. Mosheh משֶׂה 767 proper name, masculine Moses , the great Hebrew leader, prophet and lawgiver (probably = Egyptian mes, mesu, child , son , Eb GS 539 , compare Di Exod 2:10 , where see also older (abandoned) etymology); — ׳מ 2:10 + משֶׁ֑ה 2:15 +; name occurs 706 t. in Hexateuch (Exodus 290 t, Leviticus 86 t., Numbers 233 t., Deuteronomy 38 t., Joshua 59 t.), Judges 4 t. + Judg 18:30 where read משֶׁה for מְנַשֶּׁה (compare GFM); 1Sam 12:6 , 8 , Kings 10 t., Micah 6:4 ; Jer 15:1 ; Isa 63:11-12 , Malachi 3:22; Psalm 77:21 7 t.; Chronicles 3 t., Dan 9:11 , 13 ; — Moses was son of Amram and Jochebed Exod 6:20 ; Num 26:59 (both P), 1 Chronicles 5:29; 1Chr 23:13 ; of tribe of Levi Exod 2:1 (E; compare also foregoing); (younger) brother of Aaron 4:14 (J), 7:1-2 , 7 (P), etc., and brother of Miriam Num 26:59 (P), 1 Chronicles 5:29 (compare Exod 15:20 E); called prophet Deut 18:15 , 18 ; 34:10 ; agent by whom ׳י gave law Exod 20:19-20 , 21 , 22 (E) +; especially P ( י ׳צִוָּת ׳אֶתמֿ כַּאֲשֶׁר , etc.), 39:1 , 5 , 7 , 21 , 26 , 29 , 31 ; 40:19 , 21 , 25 , 27 , 29 , 32 ; Lev 7:38 ; 8:9 , 13 , 17 , 27 , 29 + often; lawgiver Deut 33:4 ; Josh 1:7 ; 1:13 (D) +; priest, ׳מ בְּכִהֲנָיו וְאַהֲרֹן Psa 99:6 . Phrases are — ( עַבְדִּי עַבְדּוֺ, , etc.) ׳מ י ׳עֶבֶר Exod 14:31 (J), Num 12:7 (E), Deut 34:5 (JE), Josh 1:1 (D) + 15 t. Joshua. (D); 1Kin 8:53 , 56 ; 2Kin 18:12 ; 21:8 ; Malachi 3:22; 2Chr 1:3 ; 24:6 ; Neh 1:8 ; 9:14 ; Psa 105:26 ; ׳מ אלהים עֶבֶד 1Chr 6:34 ; 24:9 ; Neh 10:30 ; Dan 9:11 ; ׳מ הָאֱלּהִים אִישׁ Ezra 3:2 ; Psa 90:1 מ ׳תּוֺרַת Josh 8:32 (D), 1Kin 2:3 ; 2Kin 23:25 ; Malachi 3:22; 2Chr 23:18 ; 30:16 ; Ezra 3:2 ; 7:6 ; Dan 9:11 , 13 ; מ ׳סֵפֶר 2Chr 25:4 ; 35:12 ; Neh 13:1 ; מ תּוֺרַת ׳סֵפֶר Josh 8:13 (D), 23:6 (D), 2Kin 14:6 ; Neh 8:1 .
